(rule! (lambda (grid)
  ;; The two smallest objects each recolor their bbox-INTERIOR cells (those still holding the
  ;; object's own color) to 1 and 2 respectively. filter the interior cells, then recolor-cells.
  (let ((objs (sort-by (objects grid 0) obj-size)))
    (reduce
      (lambda (g pair)
        (let* ((obj (fst pair)) (color (snd pair))
               (r1 (obj-r1 obj)) (c1 (obj-c1 obj))
               (r2 (obj-r2 obj)) (c2 (obj-c2 obj)) (oc (obj-color obj))
               (inner (filter (lambda (p)
                        (and (> (fst p) r1) (< (fst p) r2) (> (snd p) c1) (< (snd p) c2)
                             (= (at grid (fst p) (snd p)) oc)))
                      (grid-positions grid))))
          (recolor-cells g inner color)))
      grid (zip-lists objs (list 1 2))))))

(rule! (lambda (grid)
  ;; The two smallest objects each recolor their bbox-INTERIOR cells (those still holding the
  ;; object's own color) to 1 and 2 respectively. filter the interior cells, then recolor-cells.
  (let ((objs (let* ((raw-objs (objects grid 0))
             (a (first raw-objs))
             (b (second raw-objs))
             (row-distance
               (abs (- (+ (obj-r1 a) (obj-r2 a))
                       (+ (obj-r1 b) (obj-r2 b)))))
             (col-distance
               (abs (- (+ (obj-c1 a) (obj-c2 a))
                       (+ (obj-c1 b) (obj-c2 b)))))
             (row-axis (> row-distance col-distance)))
        (sort raw-objs
              (lambda (x y)
                (if row-axis
                    (if (= (obj-r1 x) (obj-r1 y))
                        (< (obj-c1 x) (obj-c1 y))
                        (< (obj-r1 x) (obj-r1 y)))
                    (if (= (obj-c1 x) (obj-c1 y))
                        (< (obj-r1 x) (obj-r1 y))
                        (< (obj-c1 x) (obj-c1 y)))))))))
    (reduce
      (lambda (g pair)
        (let* ((obj (fst pair)) (color (snd pair))
               (r1 (obj-r1 obj)) (c1 (obj-c1 obj))
               (r2 (obj-r2 obj)) (c2 (obj-c2 obj)) (oc (obj-color obj))
               (inner (filter (lambda (p)
                        (and (> (fst p) r1) (< (fst p) r2) (> (snd p) c1) (< (snd p) c2)
                             (= (at grid (fst p) (snd p)) oc)))
                      (grid-positions grid))))
          (recolor-cells g inner color)))
      grid (zip-lists objs (list 1 2))))))
